title: Synthetic probe outcomes need their own denominator
method: Synthetic hourly schedule: 60/5=12 probes; 11/12=91.7% observed success. Sparse probes do not estimate all-user availability without an appropriate sampling model.
alt: Synthetic probe outcomes need their own denominator: Expected attempts 12 attempts, Completed 11 attempts, Timed out 1 attempts. Illustrative inputs.
